note: Three fictional fuel operators for the fuel kit (P207). Names are placeholders: people decide what players read. Palettes and mark shapes are invented; they must never copy a real operator's name, logo or full trade dress (brand rule, Art Bible). Paint keys feed citylib/fuel_kit.py (sRGB hex into COLOR_0).
